page.layout: One scanned object: the outside back cover of a bound book (marbled/speckled paper boards with leather corners and spine). No printed text block on this image. The spine at the right edge carries a partly visible printed label fragment and a paper shelf label with handwritten/printed number; these are not transcribed.
page.notes: Back board of a binding, no printed text on the page. Visible on the spine strip at the right edge: fragments of a gilt title (letters "R" and "A" only partly visible) and a paper shelf label with a number (9...), which are library marks and not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature.
